bug_semantics: Under proxy authentication with a non-default auth.logoutPage, http/auth.go renewableErr treats jwt.ErrTokenExpired as renewable on the strength of the signed token alone. withUser consults that waiver on every protected route, so an expired but validly signed JWT continues to authenticate, including administrative routes, and can be exchanged for a fresh token at /api/renew (CWE-613).
flaw_origin: PR #3884 first wrote renewableErr in 07fe90ff5f093f7086fe0c811f9daba262c6b120 ('allow renewal of token if its safe to do so when using proxy auth with custom login') on jake-dog/filebrowser; parent 8dd871df1793e0d481ad01e88f007b89929fc347 only added logoutPage and still required a valid unexpired token. The waiver later squash-landed on filebrowser/filebrowser as b9ac45d5dac4b4eb2ba364629090fbf306cffd2b.
